name: koovo-workbench
description: Accounting Data Review Workbench: NestJS API (api/) + React UI (web/)

scripts.postinstall: pnpm --dir api install && pnpm --dir web install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --dir api start:dev" "pnpm --dir web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir api build && pnpm --dir web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir api typecheck && pnpm --dir web typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir api lint:check && pnpm --dir web lint
scripts.format: pnpm --dir api format && pnpm --dir web format
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir api format:check && pnpm --dir web format:check
scripts.test: pnpm --dir api test && pnpm --dir api test:integration && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
